messages:
chris-sre: heads up — starting seeing sustained 429s from prom-recv-proxy in us-west1, mostly affecting gpu-exporter sidecars. p95 remote_write latency climbed from ~400ms to ~2.1s and the proxy queues are growing. Anyone touching relabels or proxy autoscaling?

mia: not me. i was looking at exporter metrics and series_count jumped ~10x in the last 30m. looks correlated with a handful of nodes.

raj: grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood/d/remote-write/remote-write-overview?orgId=1 shows the bump. series_count and series_per_push both spiked. could be a noisy label.

ton y: @mia can you paste last 3 log lines from the exporter pod you saw?

mia: sure — from gpu-exporter-2c7f:
`2026-03-18T12:03:08Z exporter INFO: push batch size=120 series=4800 duration=0.38s`
`2026-03-18T12:04:12Z relabel DEBUG: added_label job_variant=canary`
`2026-03-18T12:04:58Z exporter WARN: scrape_duration_seconds=4.2`

lucy: that relabel line stands out — we merged a relabel in staging for job_variant last week. prod rollout was supposed to be gated but maybe a config leak happened during a configmap sync.

ops-bot: Alert: RemoteWriteLatencyHigh fired (us-west1) — p95_remote_write_latency > 1s for 5m. Pager: false. Link: https://alerts.redwood/alerts/1234

chris-sre: short-term mitigation: scale the proxy pool +2 replicas and apply conservative per-tenant rate-limits so queues drain. long-term: identify noisy labels and drop them at the scrape/relabel stage. we need a quick relabel patch to drop ephemeral labels (build ids, pod annotations).

raj: suggestion for relabel snippet to drop build-id-like labels:
```
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_build_id]
  action: drop
```
That should remove dozens of unique series introduced by CI metadata.

mia: i can patch a canary relabel to the us-west1 scrape config and route a small subset of nodes through it. will also tail the proxy metrics.

tony: i'll spin up one extra proxy and temporarily cordon off the most chatty node (node-az3-07) from scrapes. tagging runbook ops-remote-write.

lucy: also propose adjusting the alert to trigger on rate_of_change(series_count, 5m) > X instead of absolute p95, so we get earlier signal for cardinality blasts and less noise for slow drift.

chris-sre: good plan. mia drop the canary manifest id here when ready and i'll monitor p95 and queue_len. if the relabel reduces series count we can roll prod-wide.

ops-bot: action: scaled prom-recv-proxy deployment to 4 replicas (was 2) — timestamp 1749991350

mia: canary applied: configmap/prom-scrape-us-west1 patched (canary-20260318-1). watching.

chris-sre: thanks. leaving this thread open until queues back to baseline. if anyone sees related flares in other regions please ping. :eyes:
